model.basis:
(survey_constraints.md section 9.4 item 6): with the MCU in reset U1.3 is high impedance, R127 (1 k)
holds PYRO1_GATE_N, R126 (220 R) feeds the gate and R128 (10 k) ties it to its source (check_actuators 4 / 4c pin these
values). A hard short from a source of open-circuit voltage Vth and resistance Rth puts on the gate
  to GATE_N: Vth * Rn / (Rth + Rn) * R128 / (R126 + R128),   Rn = R127 || (R126 + R128)
  to GATE:   Vth * Rg / (Rth + Rg),                          Rg = R128 || (R126 + R127)
Sources, with the board armed at the 2S pack's 8.4 V maximum (REQUIREMENTS F9): a sense node is its divider's
Thevenin (8.4 V / 11.2 through 10.2 k || 1 k); a sense line's MCU side the same plus the 4.7 k series resistor; a
midpoint 8.4 V * 6.1 / 11.2 through 5.1 k || 6.1 k; GND and pads with no net 0 V; COLD (BAT54A from 3V3), every rail,
armed-live net and driven logic net is stiff (>= 3.3 V through 0 ohm). The AON7524's minimum threshold is 0.4 V at
25 C (Alpha & Omega AON7524 data sheet, lower hot); GATE_RESET_MAX = 0.2 V keeps a factor of two (survey P-7).
ARM1_SENSE through its divider gives 0.37 V (the R8P1-PYRO-04 figure); an MCU-side sense line gives 0.10 V.

pyro.divider.note: pin_ma_via_4k7 = (V_source - 3.3 V) / 4.7 k: a hard short on the node side of the 4.7 k, MCU pin taken at the 3.3 V rail (Calc; F8: about 1 mA for an 8.4 V source)

pyro.wire_room.note: fit_check prints the bore-wall figures (J121 / J124 6.4-7.0 mm at 5.0 mm height): gate/check_sh.txt

C303.deviation: the pi network's first shunt at the bias-tap node, east of the line, turned 90 degrees with its GND end aft: the west side is free for the limiter vias and the east keeps a stitching spot (D-S4-02)

D30.deviation: turned 180 degrees: its GND pad west of the line, so the east side keeps a stitching spot (D-S4-02)

model.basis: pass2_rf section 3.12 (R7 pass 2): launch 49 ohm x 4.2 mm then 0.2 mm at about 70 ohm, the line at its solved Z0, the ESD diode 0.2 pF (Infineon ESD103-B1-02 DS rev 1.3 Table 3, maximum at 1 MHz), the bias choke >= 500 ohm (u-blox), the DNP shunts as open stubs ending in 0.03 pF, the 0 ohm series part as 0.4 nH, the module port 50 ohm (all but the drawn lengths and the solved impedances are assumptions, as in pass 2: Inference)
